description.blurb: The Ulysses mission made nearly three complete orbits of the Sun during more than 18 years in service.
description.more: Ulysses was launched in 1990 and made three "fast latitude scans" of the Sun in 1994/1995, 2000/2001, and 2007/2008. In addition, the probe studied several comets. The vehicle was designed to fly a unique trajectory that would use a gravity assist from Jupiter to take it out of the plane of the solar system. Ulysses found that the solar wind has become progressively weaker over the last 50 years.
